basics.name: Junsang Park
basics.label: Undergraduate Researcher
basics.summary: Undergraduate student at Seoul National University studying Chemical and Biological Engineering with a minor in Computer Science and Engineering. I work on structure-based machine learning for biomolecules, with a focus on protein structure modeling and protein-ligand interactions.

education.area: Chemical and Biological Engineering, minor in Computer Science and Engineering
courses: Relevant courses: Deep Learning (graduate), Computer Vision, Molecular Biochemical Engineering

education.institution: Daejeon Science High School for the Gifted
courses: Specialized high school for gifted students in science and mathematics

experience.name: Computational Biology Laboratory, Seoul National University
experience.summary: Structure-based machine learning for understanding dynamic biomolecular behavior.
highlights: Investigating structural determinants of GPCR agonism and antagonism and their coupling to receptor conformational dynamics
Contributing to protein-ligand complex modeling for the CASP17 Ligand Prediction category
Initiating a study of the structural and dynamic basis of CBAD-mediated regulation in IL-17RA signaling

experience.name: Biomedical & Health Informatics Laboratory, Seoul National University
experience.summary: Protein language model-guided antibody engineering and mutation effect prediction.
highlights: Contributed to an ESM-based protein language model pipeline that proposes sequence mutations via ensemble voting
Supported implementation and evaluation of the AbAgNet ddG predictor for mutation-induced changes in antibody-antigen binding affinity

projects.name: CBPL-kit: interactive Hunter-Nash LLE simulator
projects.summary: Lead developer of an interactive platform for visualizing multistage liquid-liquid extraction using the Hunter-Nash method.
highlights: Designed interactive ternary-diagram visualizations and stage-by-stage calculations that connect phase-equilibrium theory with extraction process design
Scheduled for integration into an undergraduate chemical engineering course at Seoul National University in Fall 2026
